note: Advisories intentionally OUT OF SCOPE for langdoctor -- never alerted by the advisory watcher. Criteria: (1) pre-2025 (2023-2024) historical langchain / langchain-core CVEs in code paths langdoctor does not model (old chains, agents, SQL/PAL exec, community tools); (2) advisories for a package/code path langdoctor does not model that OSV cross-lists onto a covered package, where the fix only affects a line we do not flag (e.g. LangSmith SDK issues attached to langchain and fixed before the 1.x line) -- these can be recent. NOT for deferred-but-planned coverage such as the Langflow long tail -- that is tracked via .watch-state.json instead. Matching is by any identifier, so a CVE here also suppresses its paired GHSA/PYSEC records.
